3.3.3  
    
      Representing Tables
      テーブルの表現

child.body:
const memo_fib = memoize(n => n === 0
                              ? 0
                              : n === 1
                              ? 1
                              : memo_fib(n - 1) +
                                memo_fib(n - 2)
                        );
